Workspace setup. Tell WorkPulse when your team works, so attendance and productivity are measured on the right days and hours.
Open Settings, and choose the Workspace tab.
In Workspace profile, check the workspace name and the default time zone. Days and hours are counted in this time zone. Click Save changes.
In Working days and holidays, tick the days your team works. For example, Monday to Saturday, for a six day week.
Days that are not ticked, like Sunday, are shown as holidays, not as absence.

Next, set the required hours for each working day. This is the active time a person should reach, with breaks excluded. For example, nine thirty to six, with a forty minute break, is seven hours fifty minutes.
Saturday can have its own, shorter requirement. Leave it at zero for no requirement.
Add company holidays. Pick a date, and click Add holiday. A holiday is never counted as absence.
Click Save schedule. The Attendance report now compares each person's active time with these hours.
Done. Next, choose what WorkPulse monitors, in Monitoring and privacy.
